description: Palette settings applied to real CSS Loader Theme Store components through the installed plugin API.

required.name: Chromahon (Steam Menu)
required.reason: Structural customization for the STEAM button side menu.

required.name: Chromahon (Input Controls)
required.reason: Structural customization for controller/footer input hints.

required.name: Chromahon (QAM)
required.reason: Structural customization for the ... Quick Access Menu.

recommended.name: Round
recommended.reason: Softens cards, panels and controls so the neon UI feels cohesive rather than boxy.
recommended.settings: Start moderate (roughly 6-12px equivalent). Avoid extreme rounding until the stack is stable.

recommended.name: Full Screen Menus
recommended.reason: Makes Steam Menu/QAM taller and cleaner while preserving the Chromahon structure.
recommended.settings: Start full-height with Steam Menu around 50-75% width and QAM around 50%, then tune to taste.

recommended.name: Colored Keyboard
recommended.reason: Extends the Bubble Gum Rave color language to Steam's on-screen keyboard.
recommended.settings: Use the closest magenta/cyan/purple preset; Bubble Gum Rave does not replace keyboard layout.

recommended.name: Centered Game Text
recommended.reason: Centers the selected-game title for a cleaner console-style home screen.
recommended.settings: Default is a good starting point; keep text visible with Art Hero before hiding other home labels.

recommended.name: DellyVolume
recommended.reason: Cleans up the volume overlay and fits the polished console-like presentation.
recommended.settings: Start with its default/compact presentation; verify it still reads well over Better Blur.

recommended.name: Better Game Icons
recommended.reason: Cleans up small library/game icons and makes non-Steam entries feel less out of place.
recommended.settings: Prefer transparent background; keep icon radius low if Round is already handling global rounding.

recommended.name: Better Game Badges
recommended.reason: Improves badge treatment so compatibility/status badges look intentional rather than bolted on.
recommended.settings: Start at defaults; verify ProtonDB/Deck Verified/non-Steam badges remain legible.

recommended.name: Top Bar Transparency
recommended.reason: Removes the heavy stock top bar so art and neon accents breathe more naturally.
recommended.settings: Use transparent or mostly transparent; keep enough contrast for clock/network/battery readability.

recommended.name: Better Blur
recommended.reason: Adds controlled glass-like blur behind UI panels and pairs well with OLED black plus neon accents.
recommended.settings: Start around blur strength 4 and opacity about 0.3 if those options are present; reduce before increasing.

recommended.name: Better Achievements
recommended.reason: Polishes achievement presentation on game pages without changing core navigation.
recommended.settings: Defaults first; treat this as cosmetic and disable early if a Steam update breaks game-detail pages.

recommended.name: Game Cover Reflections
recommended.reason: Adds a subtle reflection under recent-game covers for a more finished console-style carousel.
recommended.settings: Keep reflection strength subtle so OLED blacks and cover art remain the focus.

recommended.name: Percentages
recommended.reason: Adds useful numeric volume/brightness readouts to QAM/settings without adding another plugin.
recommended.settings: Enable the readouts you care about; volume + brightness are the useful defaults.

recommended.name: No Game Count
recommended.reason: Removes collection/library game-count clutter for a cleaner home/library presentation.
recommended.settings: Enable as-is if you prefer minimalism; no tuning needed.

recommended.name: Art Hero
recommended.reason: Makes the home screen art-forward with a larger hero. Great fit for the OLED but a meaningful layout change.
recommended.settings: Good starting point: expanded hero, small/default footer, slightly reduced hero/carousel heights. Tune after Centered Game Text.

recommended.name: Clean Gameview
recommended.reason: Cleans and modernizes the game-detail page. Useful, but it modifies one of Steam's more update-sensitive layouts.
recommended.settings: Start with a blurred play bar and centered/zoom-centered alignment if available; keep Steam Cloud/status visible.

recommended.name: Clean Game Launch
recommended.reason: Simplifies the launch screen so starting a game matches the rest of the clean console-style UI.
recommended.settings: Defaults first. If it offers filter-removal/extra-clean options, enable only after verifying launch dialogs still expose needed choices.

recommended.name: Focus Highlight Color
recommended.reason: Colors the focused selection border with the Bubble Gum Rave palette.

optional.name: Hero Zoom Eradication
optional.reason: Stops some hero-art zoom behavior and can make Art Hero/Clean Gameview feel steadier.
optional.settings: Only enable if the hero zoom bothers you or clashes with Art Hero.

optional.name: No Home Edge Fade
optional.reason: Removes the stock home-edge fade so custom art/background treatments stay cleaner.
optional.settings: Enable after Art Hero/Better Blur so you can judge readability.

optional.name: Mini Carousel
optional.reason: Shrinks the recent-games carousel and gives hero art more room; pairs especially well with Art Hero.
optional.settings: Use a conservative size reduction first; too small hurts handheld readability.

optional.name: Gradient Top Bar
optional.reason: Alternative to Top Bar Transparency when you want the top bar itself to carry the rave palette.
optional.settings: Use this OR Top Bar Transparency as the primary treatment, not both unless you have verified the combination.

optional.name: Game Cover Shine Animation
optional.reason: Adds animated highlight polish to covers; cosmetic only and more likely to be distracting than the reflection layer.
optional.settings: Keep subtle; disable if animations feel busy or reduce battery/UI smoothness.

optional.name: Tilted Home
optional.reason: Strong home-screen layout change. Nice visually but more conflict-prone with Art Hero and carousel themes.
optional.settings: Do not enable until the base Bubble Gum Rave profile is saved and stable.

optional.name: DellyFooter
optional.reason: Alternative footer treatment if you want a more minimal button-hint bar.
optional.settings: Optional because Chromahon Input Controls + Bubble Gum Rave already style this surface.

optional.name: Static Background
optional.reason: Lets you add a fixed Bubble Gum Rave wallpaper/background behind Game Mode.
optional.settings: Use a dark OLED-first background with restrained neon bloom; avoid bright full-screen fills.

optional.name: Faster Transition Animations
optional.reason: Makes Steam UI transitions feel snappier; useful after visual styling is stable.
optional.settings: Start modestly rather than max speed; verify menus remain readable and animations do not feel abrupt.

notes: Bubble Gum Rave is a palette and native CSS Loader profile, never a Theme Store package.
Required and recommended components, including the requested home/game layouts, install automatically; remaining optional components stay opt-in.
Color controls are discovered from the loaded plugin schema; unknown controls are reported instead of faking success.
SteamGridDB owns Gaming Mode artwork; desktop icons are independent.
